output.reason: PMK 105/2025 grants a government-borne PPh 21 incentive (DTP) for 2026. It covers the full PPh 21 on gross income of certain permanent employees whose fixed and regular gross income is at most Rp10,000,000. These employees must work for employers in the footwear, textile and apparel, furniture, leather and tourism industries with the listed KLU codes. The DTP amount must be paid in cash to the employee and is not counted as taxable income. Together these change the PPh 21 payable and the take-home calculation for eligible permanent employees for the January–December 2026 tax periods.
